name: UNICEF
body: Preloaded HSTS, Organization JSON-LD, and five language versions linked to each other. But the search date filter on every page analyzed is named only by placeholder text, which vanishes as you type.
lesson: Give every field a <label> or an aria-label. A placeholder is a hint, not a name, and it disappears on input.
summary: www.unicef.org scores 84 out of 100 (B). 3 checks fail now, 12 are at risk, and 25 pass. Fix first: 20 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /fr, /es, /ar and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 10 language alternate problems
fix.evidence: /fr has no self reference, / does not link back to /fr, /es has no self reference and 7 more.
fix.fix: Each language version must list every version, itself included, and each must link back.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 2.5 s (good), Interaction to Next Paint 595 ms (poor), Cumulative Layout Shift 0 (good). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Break up long JavaScript tasks behind clicks and taps, and defer third-party scripts.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 48/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 15.3 s, Total Blocking Time 717 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.001, Speed Index 5.4 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page

Every image has an alt attribute
